mutations.note: picks the FIRST hunked block instead of the last -- if a model offers a false-start hunk followed by its real corrected hunk, the stale first one applies instead of the model's final answer.

mutations.original: hunked = [b for b in blocks if _HUNK_LINE.search(b)]
mutations.mutated: hunked = [b for b in blocks if "@@" in b]
mutations.note: loosens the hunk detector from an anchored '^@@ ' line match to a bare substring test -- a block that merely mentions '@@' in prose text (not as a real hunk header) would now count as hunked.
